items.title: DepotDownloader
items.description: A tool to download game files of a specific version.

items.title: VPulse Editor
items.description: A visual programming tool to write the vpulse script, which is a new unreleased visualized script system for source2 to replace vscript.

items.title: Schema Dumper
items.description: A metamod plugin for dumping schemas from game binary, and also able to generate a header file that can be imported in IDA for reverse engineering.

items.title: PltPatcher
items.description: A IDA python plugin to patch plt sections when IDA fails to do so automatically, you might encounter such problem when decompiling linux binaries, made by GAMMACASE.

items.title: CounterStrikeSharp
items.description: [Website] [Discord]The most popular modding framework for cs2, the plugins are written in c#.Alias: CS#, cssharp

items.title: Metamod
items.description: [Website] [Discord]The cobblestone of all of the current open source framework since source1, written in C++, hard to develop but have access to fundamental things.Please notice that it's the dev branch that support cs2, make sure you download the right version.

items.title: SwiftlyS2
items.description: [Website] [Discord]A modding framework that support c#, with more features than counterstrikesharp.

items.title: Plugify
items.description: [Website] [Discord]A modding framework that support tons of programming languages, more information can be found in there discord channel and website.
These are the websites with resources that you might need to check during development.

items.title: cstrike15_src
items.description: CSGO Leaked source code in 2020, cs2 is still using some codes from it.

items.title: ConVars
items.description: A list of all cs2 convars, directly dumped from latest cs2 binary.

items.title: Commands
items.description: A list of all cs2 commands, directly dumped from latest cs2 binary.

items.title: Game Events
items.description: A list of all cs2 game events.The data might be outdated, if so, you can find the latest ones here:core.gameevents game.gameevents mod.gameevents

items.title: Schemas
items.description: A list of all cs2 schema classes and fields, directly dumped from latest cs2 binary.

items.title: Protobufs
items.description: A list of all cs2 protobuf definitions.

items.title: HL2SDK Wend4r's fork
items.description: A fork of hl2sdk, if there's a game update, you might find what have changed in here or in pull requests.
